# Diplodocus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Diplodocus mean?", "double beam"),
    ("What did Diplodocus eat?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "double beam"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Jurassic"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "154-152"),
    ("What is length?", "26 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "herbivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
